instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a full shot from a low angle captures an indoor motion capture studio with a dark red carpeted floor and white walls. The woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the left with her back to the camera, extending her right arm to hold the hand of the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1). The man (R1) stands on the right, facing the camera and looking down at their joined hands. The scene is illuminated by even overhead indoor lighting, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
elements: R2 extends her right arm to hold R1's hand
R1 looks down at the joined hands while R2 has her back to the camera
R2 uses her right hand as the active reaching hand toward R1
R1 and R2 are connected by joined hands
